summary: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Corp., a Delaware BDC, filed an 8-K covering unregistered share sales, a Regulation FD distribution update and other events. Between October 1 and October 16, 2026 it sold 4,206,197 Class I shares for $103.1M, 19,378 Class S shares for $0.475M and 20,397 Class D shares for $0.5M under subscription agreements relying on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D/Regulation S. The board declared a $0.1850 per-share September distribution payable October 29, 2026 to holders of record September 30. Routine continuous-offering capital raising, not a special situation.
